title: Prediction-powered Neural Architecture Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.01317v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluating candidate architectures in neural architecture search (NAS) faces an inherent trade-off: on the one hand, reliable performance labels are limited because training and evaluating architectures is costly; on the other hand, zero-cost proxies (ZCPs) are cheap to compute at large scale but can be noisy. Yet, how to effectively combine these two sources of supervision remains unclear. In this paper, we propose PPNAS, a novel prediction-powered inference (PPI) approach for NAS. PPNAS fuses (1) a small set of architectures with observed performance labels and (2) a large set of architectures with ZCP information. To combine these two sources of supervision, PPNAS exploits the ordinal information provided by ZCPs to construct additional pairwise ranking supervision, while PPI debiases systematic discrepancies between ZCP-based and true performance rankings. translated_title: 预测驱动的神经架构搜索
translated_abstract: 神经架构搜索（NAS）中候选架构的评估面临一个固有的权衡：一方面，由于训练和评估架构的成本高昂，可靠的性能标签数量有限；另一方面，零成本代理在更大规模上计算成本低廉，但可能含有噪声。然而，如何有效结合这两种监督来源仍不明确。本文提出了 PPNAS，一种用于 NAS 的新型预测驱动推断（PPI）方法。PPNAS 融合了（1）一小部分具有真实观测性能标签的架构和（2）大量具有零成本代理信息的架构。为了结合这两种监督来源，PPNAS 利用零成本代理提供的序数信息来构建额外的成对排序监督，同时利用预测驱动推断对基于零成本代理的排序与真实性能排序之间的系统性偏差进行去偏。我们在端到端的基于预测器的 NAS 中对 PPNAS 进行了评估，它实现了最先进的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: PPNAS 提出了一种基于预测驱动推断的神经架构搜索新方法，将少量真实性能标签与大量零成本代理信息融合，利用序数信息构建成对排序监督并消除系统性偏差，从而显著提升架构性能预测的效果。
en_tdlr: PPNAS introduces a prediction-powered inference framework for neural architecture search that fuses a small set of true performance labels with abundant zero-cost proxies, leveraging ordinal information for pairwise ranking supervision with debiasing to achieve state-of-the-art performance prediction.
